public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest renewable generation contribution source from the dashboard and route that source record to priority contribution follow-up.
The comparison scope is the renewable generation sources shown in the chart: Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Biomass, and Geothermal.
The rule is to select the source with the highest percentage value on the chart for routing to priority contribution follow-up.
